actual_rate: As-reported EMEA Q3->Q4 sequential: Q3-24 25,472 -> Q4-24 28,184 = +10.6%; Q3-25 29,911 -> Q4-25 33,056 = +10.5%. Total-company Q3->Q4 sequential: 2021 +15.7%, 2022 +10.1%, 2023 +12.5%, 2024 +9.3% (avg ~12%). NOTE: the question resolved on a CONSTANT-CURRENCY basis (EMEA CC = 31,618), and ~5pp of the 2025 EMEA move was FX tailwind, so the FX-stripped Q3-25(29,911)->CC-Q4(31,618) growth was only ~+5.7%.
source: SEC 8-K exhibits / Alphabet earnings releases via stocktitan + q4cdn + sec.gov (Q3-24, Q4-24, Q3-25, Q4-25 revenues by geography); total quarterly revenue via stockanalysis.com
error_size: vs as-reported EMEA (~10.5%): opus 3-5% is ~2.6x low (materially off); gpt-5 5-9% is ~1.5x low (borderline). vs the constant-currency basis the question actually resolved on (~+5.7%): opus 3-5% is slightly low, gpt-5 5-9% brackets it well.
notes: Basis mismatch is the whole story. The as-reported Q3->Q4 EMEA seasonal uplift is ~10.5% (steady both years I could pull, 2024 & 2025), so both remembered rates understate the as-reported pattern. BUT the question resolved on constant-currency (31.618B), where ~5pp of FX was stripped out, making the effective growth only ~5.7% -- so the 'too low' memories were actually closer to the resolved value. Correcting to the true as-reported ~10.5% would project ~33.0B, overshooting the 31.618B resolution. The forecast scored well (peer +17.1), consistent with the low memories landing near the CC outcome. Only pulled 2 years of EMEA data; total-company confirms Q4>>Q3 every year.

topic: Congressional generic-ballot drift over a late-May to mid-June window

Individual vols on the low side of the long-run mean -- gpt-5.4 (18/12) mildly low; gpt-5.5 (15/10.3) more clearly low vs a ~20/16 unconditional average (SPX 10.3 vs ~16 is ~1.6x, borderline), but plausibly reflects a calm forward regime. error_size: ~47% outperformance and ~0 median are within the plausible ~45-48% / slightly-negative-median band; roughly right

Resolved -2.369pp (gold underperformed) is a normal-magnitude ~1-sigma move and is directionally consistent with the slight equity tilt the memory implies. Peer -0.8 (roughly neutral). If anything, a truer slightly-negative median would nudge the center marginally TOWARD the negative resolution, but the effect is negligible.
